responsibility: Implements the public MMX-compatibility intrinsic header for Arm iWMMXt/WMMX targets. It defines the __m64 type family and a large set of inline wrappers and compatibility aliases that map MMX-style pack, unpack, arithmetic, shift, logic, compare, extract/insert, mask, alignment, and control operations onto Arm iWMMXt builtins or inline assembly, giving source-level SIMD compatibility for WMMX-enabled Arm targets.
